body_text: News & Highlights News & Press Releases Presentations Events Sign up for Alerts View printer-friendly version << Back Pitney Bowes Achieves IL4 Provisional Authorization for SendPro® 360 Platform Solutions, Expanding Secure Shipping and Mailing Capabilities for the U.S. Department of Defense This authorization builds on Pitney Bowes’ commitment to secure, compliant cloud-based sending solutions for federal and defense agencies SHELTON, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 28, 2026-- Pitney Bowes (NYSE: PBI), a technology-driven company that provides digital shipping solutions, mailing innovation, and financial services to clients around the world, today announced it has achieved Provisional Authorization for Impact Level 4 (IL4) for its SendPro® 360 platform solutions. This milestone enables U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) agencies and authorized defense contractors to leverage SendPro 360 to manage shipping and mailing operations in alignment with stringent DoD cloud security requirements. The Provisional Authorization, granted through the DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG) process, validates that SendPro 360 meets the rigorous controls required to process and store Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and other mission-sensitive data at Impact Level 4. This provides defense agencies and supporting organizations with confidence that Pitney Bowes’ cloud-based shipping and mailing platform aligns with DoD cybersecurity and risk management standards. “Achieving IL4 Provisional Authorization reflects our continued investment in delivering secure, compliant solutions for the public sector,” said Todd Everett, Executive Vice President and President of Sending Technology Solutions, Pitney Bowes. “Government and defense organizations operate in complex, highly regulated environments. With SendPro 360, they can streamline shipping and mailing operations while meeting the highest standards for data protection and operational resilience.” Secure, Scalable Shipping and Mailing for Mission-Critical Environments SendPro 360 is an enterprise shipping and mailing platform designed to centralize carrier management, automate shipping workflows, control costs and provide real-time visibility across distributed locations. With IL4 Provisional Authorization, DoD agencies and authorized contractors can deploy SendPro 360 to: Manage mailing and multi-carrier shipping across field offices while enforcing sending policies and automating compliance controls Track inbound packages and manage secure distribution through integrated smart locker systems for controlled pickup and chain-of-custody Enhance tracking, reporting and audit readiness Protect CUI and other sensitive information within a secure cloud environment In addition to its IL4 Provisional Authorization, Pitney Bowes has achieved Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) 1.0 certification. These milestones build on Pitney Bowes’ broader commitment to public sector compliance, including prior FedRAMP and GovRAMP authorizations for the cloud-based SendPro 360 platform. Together, these credentials underscore the company’s ability to meet the evolving cybersecurity and risk management needs of federal, state and local government agencies. Enabling Modernization Across Defense Logistics As defense agencies modernize supply chains and digitize back-office operations, secure cloud platforms play a critical role in improving efficiency and accountability. By achieving IL4 Provisional Authorization, Pitney Bowes helps ensure that shipping and mailing operations can be integrated into secure digital ecosystems that support mission readiness. “Modern logistics require both agility and security,” added Todd Everett. “With SendPro 360 now authorized at IL4, defense organizations can confidently modernize shipping and mailing processes without compromising compliance.” For more information about Pitney Bowes public sector solutions, visit www.pitneybowes.com . About Pitney Bowes Pitney Bowes (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500. Small businesses, retail brands, enterprise clients and government agencies rely on Pitney Bowes to simplify the sending of mail and parcels. For more information, visit www.pitneybowes.com . summary: The Power of 1: Match Contact Lenses to Lifestyle for a Better Fit matthew.cave Fri, 04/24/2026 - 17:43 Story Headline The Power of 1: Match Contact Lenses to Lifestyle for a Better Fit Story Teaser Summary Hear from our VP and GM of Global Vision Care, Max Wolf and Industry Leading Eye Care Professionals on How Alcon’s WATERINNOVATIONS™ Portfolio redefines revolutionary fit, encouraging compliance Story Date Mon, 04/27/2026 - 12:00 Featured 1 Category Bold Innovation Hero image Max Wolf: For many Eye Care Professionals (ECPs), helping patients find the best solution starts with a simple question: What does their daily routine look like? Are they staring at screens for hours, chasing toddlers, traveling for work, cooking, sitting in all-day meetings, training for their next marathon, or all of the above? Every lifestyle brings its own visual challenges — and every patient deserves a lens that keeps up with their daily demands. Alcon’s priority is to offer ECPs solutions that meet patients’ increasingly complex lifestyles and vision needs. WATERINNOVATIONS™ Portfolio is built to meet these demands. Using the concept of “The Power of 1” — one day, one week, or one month — ECPs can provide patients with a simple formula to find lenses that match their lifestyle and comfort needs. Whether it’s daily disposables, 1-week lenses to 1-month lenses, the WATERINNOVATIONS™ portfolio of lenses delivers comfort,1-5† performance, and convenience, all designed to help ECPs successfully meet patient needs. Despite vastly different locations and patient profiles, there is one universal finding among the group — a successful fit is more than just vision correction. It’s about developing a partnership that gives patients the power to choose comfortable and convenient vision that fits their everyday lives. How do you approach fitting patients with lenses that fit their lifestyle, not just their refractive needs? ECP 1 (DR. JESSILIN QUINT, UNITED STATES): It starts with listening. Before I even look at the chart, I ask about their daily routine: how long they’re on screens, whether they commute, what their weekends look like, whether they wear makeup or have allergies. Each of those details helps to guide my recommendation. That’s when the real story of their eyes comes through. Someone who wakes up early or stays up late on a laptop has very different comfort needs from a weekend athlete or a retiree rediscovering travel, joining a book club, or trying new hobbies. ECP 2 (DR. AARON LUEKENGA, UNITED STATES): Each patient has different needs based on their lifestyle. For contact lens wearers, meeting those needs effectively can mean the difference between a successful fit and dropout. Many patients stop wearing lenses because of end-of-day discomfort.9 It rarely has anything to do with their prescription. When I successfully match the lens to their life, I see far fewer dropouts and better outcomes overall. ECP 3 (DR. JULIA YI TING LI, CHINA): I have a patient who is a lawyer and an avid soccer player. He came to me on the verge of quitting contact lenses altogether because they were so uncomfortable. title: Rambus DDR5 RDIMM 8000 Chipset Named Semiconductor Product of the Year from the Data Breakthrough Award
summary: At Rambus, we spend a lot of time solving hard problems at the intersection of memory and compute. Bandwidth limits. Power integrity. Signal integrity.
body_text: At Rambus, we spend a lot of time solving hard problems at the intersection of memory and compute. Bandwidth limits. Power integrity. Signal integrity. Thermal constraints. These challenges become even more complex as AI training, inference, and high-performance computing push memory subsystems to their limits. That is why industry recognition matters less as a trophy and more as validation that the work is moving the needle for our customers. We are proud to share that the Rambus DDR5 RDIMM 8000 Chipset has been named “Semiconductor Product of the Year” in the 7th Annual Data Breakthrough Awards program. The award recognizes technologies that are advancing the global data ecosystem, and this honor underscores the impact our latest memory interface chipset is having across data center and AI platforms. The Rambus DDR5 RDIMM 8000 solution introduces a next-generation memory interface chipset designed to enable RDIMMs operating at up to 8000 MT/s. That speed unlocks higher sustained memory bandwidth, a critical requirement for today’s AI and HPC workloads where compute capability continues to scale dramatically. In modern data centers, memory bandwidth has become a limiting factor. Addressing that imbalance is exactly where this solution delivers value. At the core of the DDR5 RDIMM 8000 solution is the industry’s first Gen5 DDR5 Registering Clock Driver designed to operate at 8000 MT/s. Rambus pairs this with the PMIC5030, the industry’s highest efficiency power management IC for this speed. Together, these chips, along with the Rambus SPD Hub and Temperature Sensor ICs, address the signal integrity, timing closure, and power delivery challenges that emerge in dense, thermally constrained server environments. The result is measurable performance headroom at the memory channel. Moving power management onto the module is a key part of that equation. By enabling more granular voltage control and improving power integrity, the solution is purpose-built to support the bandwidth demands of generative AI and memory-intensive HPC applications. The PMIC5030 also provides compatibility with Rambus MRDIMM 12800, offering additional memory bandwidth as customers plan their future server memory roadmaps. Beyond raw performance, the DDR5 RDIMM 8000 solution delivers real benefits for server OEMs and memory module designers. With proven silicon solutions, customers can achieve improved reliability, greater margins, and faster time to market for RDIMMs targeting hyperscale and enterprise data centers. That combination of performance, efficiency, and readiness are delivered by this platform-ready solution. According to Data Breakthrough, the Data Breakthrough Awards program is one of the most competitive and respected recognition platforms in the industry, drawing thousands of nominations from around the world. Being selected as Semiconductor Product of the Year reflects both the technical innovation behind the DDR5 RDIMM 8000 Chipset and its relevance to the data economy as AI continues to reshape computing infrastructure. This award also reinforces Rambus’ important role in the computing landscape. Addressing the bottleneck between memory and processing is foundational to the future of AI infrastructure. With the DDR5 RDIMM 8000 Chipset, Rambus is helping data centers move forward with higher bandwidth, better efficiency, and greater reliability in their server memory subsystems. “The Rambus DDR5 RDIMM 8000 offers a proven silicon and a production ready enablement stack for OEMs and module customers. Generative AI and memory-intensive workloads expose main memory as a major limiter. Data centers are bandwidth bound with CPUs and accelerators scaling compute at an exponential pace, resulting in main memory struggling to keep up,” said Steve Johansson, Managing Director, Data Breakthrough. “With the Rambus chipset, module designers realize greater margins, improved stability and faster time to market for memory modules serving hyperscale and enterprise customers. Congratulations to Rambus for winning ‘Semiconductor Product of the Year.’” We thank Data Breakthrough for this recognition and extend congratulations to the Rambus teams whose expertise and persistence made this possible. We remain focused on what lies ahead: delivering industry-leading chips and IP that make data faster and safer for next-generation computing platforms. The global Data Breakthrough Awards program provides a forum for public recognition around the achievements of data companies and solutions in categories including data analytics, DataOps, data management, infrastructure and hardware, storage, Business Intelligence and more. body_text: HAMILTON, Bermuda , April 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Borr Drilling Limited (NYSE and Euronext Growth Oslo: BORR) ("Borr Drilling" or the "Company") today announced that is has completed its previously announced offering of convertible senior notes due 2033 (the "Notes"). The Company sold $300 million aggregate principal amount of the Notes, including $40 million aggregate principal amount of the Notes sold pursuant to the initial purchasers' exercise in full of their option to purchase additional Notes to cover over-allotments in connection with the offering. The Notes are senior, unsecured obligations of the Company and mature on May 1, 2033. They bear interest at a rate of 3.50% per annum, which is payable semi-annually, beginning on November 1, 2026. The Notes are convertible into the Company's common shares, cash, or a combination of shares and cash, at the Company's election. The conversion rate for the Notes will initially equal 125.0000 common shares per $1,000 principal amount of the Notes, which is equivalent to an initial conversion price of approximately $8.00 per common share. Such initial conversion price represents a conversion premium of over 40% with reference to the closing price of the Company's common shares of $5.70 on the New York Stock Exchange on April 14, 2026. The conversion rate is subject to adjustment upon the occurrence of certain events. The Company intends to use the proceeds from the sale of the Notes to repurchase its existing convertible bonds due 2028 (the "2028 Convertible Bonds") and for general corporate purposes. In connection with the offering, the Company has agreed with certain holders of the 2028 Convertible Bonds to repurchase $195.2 million aggregate principal amount of the 2028 Convertible Bonds. About Borr Drilling Borr Drilling Limited is an international drilling contractor incorporated in Bermuda in 2016 and listed on the New York Stock Exchange since July 31, 2019 and on Euronext Growth Oslo since December 19, 2025 under the ticker "BORR". The Company owns and operates jack-up rigs of modern and high specification designs and provides services focused on the shallow-water segment to the offshore oil and gas industry worldwide.
